# Pitch Collection

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchCollection`](gmeow-PitchCollection.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchCollection>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A set or multiset of PitchValues derived from a source (a spectrum, a tuning system, an analysis, or a projection). A projection of canonical frame-relative content, not the canonical object itself ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).
